scope: Local synthetic SDK helper enum-validation/fence behavior, installed before/after distributions, generated code and negative declaration checks only.
problem: SDK helper errors coerced kind/certainty arrays into accepted enum strings. An array containing protocol reached the caller and bypassed the protocol-error helper fence. Stream gate state likewise accepted an array as a typed active/paused value.
change: Require actual strings for error kind, error certainty and stream gate state before enum membership. Malformed replies fence the original helper. Preserve original operation key and read-only versus possibly-submitted mutation certainty. No API or deadline changes.
